items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: I don't know him. He was great alto player

ctx.x: Dennis Gishaw was playing bass, Samuel Dutre was playing tenor, we had another alto player, we used to call him Singary for nickname, he went to Cincinnati, I forget his name. Singary? Singary. We called him Singary for the cigarette. I don't know him. He was great alto player, well he and Gene Porter were close, and so they went on the boat. I left, I went with, I didn't go in the band, he said Don Albert is here. I said Don Albert has a bigger band and they're doing much traveling and he needs you much more…
